items.title: File Bellevue business and occupation tax returns
items.description: The city business license does not expire, but active licenses file B&O returns on the frequency in the welcome letter: quarterly (due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31) or annually (April 30).
items.deadlineNote: annual filers file once a year, in April

items.title: Register your business with the City of Bellingham
items.description: Businesses located or working in Bellingham register through the state's Business Licensing Service with a city fee; the registration happens once and is valid for the life of the business, with a threshold exemption for small outside businesses.

items.title: File Everett business and occupation tax returns
items.authority: City of Everett Business Tax Division
items.description: The city business license assigns a B&O tax number; annual filers are due April 30 and quarterly filers the last day of the month after each quarter.
items.deadline: April 30 for annual filers; quarterly after each quarter

items.title: Hold a Pasco business license
items.description: Businesses in Pasco, or doing business there, need a city business license endorsement obtained through the state's Business Licensing Service; some businesses may be exempt.

items.title: Renew Renton business license and file B&O tax
items.authority: City of Renton Tax and License Division
items.description: Businesses in Renton hold a city license and file a B&O tax return through FileLocal; annual filers' due date aligns with the license expiration date.

items.title: Obtain Seattle business license tax certificate and file B&O tax
items.authority: Seattle Department of Finance and Administrative Services
items.description: Seattle requires a business license tax certificate (via the state Business Licensing Service) and a Seattle B&O tax return when taxable revenue exceeds the threshold.

items.title: Hold a Spokane city endorsement on your state business license
items.authority: Washington Department of Revenue, Business Licensing Service
items.description: Doing business in Spokane requires a Washington business license with a Spokane endorsement (under the city code); certain limited activities can request an exemption.

items.title: Renew Tacoma general business license
items.authority: City of Tacoma Tax and License Division
items.description: Renewal notices are mailed in December; payment must be paid or postmarked by January 31 to avoid a late penalty. A state business license does not replace the city license.

items.title: Hold a Vancouver city business license endorsement
items.description: A city endorsement is required for businesses physically in Vancouver or working there, one per location. Renewals go through the state's Business Licensing Service and a My DOR account.
